```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Ensure knitr is loaded for table rendering
library(knitr)
```

## Report Overview

This report summarises the estimated sample sizes and cluster requirements for a **two-arm cluster randomised controlled trial**, based on the specific assumptions and parameters detailed below.

> **Disclaimer:** Figures are advisory and should be independently verified by a qualified statistician before use in trial protocols or grant applications. No responsibility is taken for their use. For questions or comments, please contact [Alexander.Perkins@LSHTM.ac.uk](mailto:Alexander.Perkins@LSHTM.ac.uk).

---

### Trial Parameters

**Outcome Type:** `r params$calculation_type`

```{r parameters, echo=FALSE}
# Convert the parameters list into a neat two-column table
cond_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(params$conditions),
  Value = as.character(unlist(params$conditions, use.names = FALSE))
)

kable(cond_df, 
      format = "html", 
      table.attr = "class='table table-striped table-hover'", 
      row.names = FALSE)
```

---

### Total Sample Size (Adjusted)

This table displays the realistic recruited sample size required across both arms, accounting for the cluster size, design effect (ICC), and expected loss to follow-up. 

```{r sample_size_table, echo=FALSE}
kable(params$sample_size_table, 
      format = "html", 
      table.attr = "class='table table-bordered table-hover'")
```

---

### Total Number of Clusters

This table displays the total number of clusters required across both arms (ensuring 1:1 allocation balance).

```{r cluster_table, echo=FALSE}
kable(params$cluster_table, 
      format = "html", 
      table.attr = "class='table table-bordered table-hover'")
```
